title: Warn Uncommitted Changes
summary: A Claude Code hook that shows which files are still uncommitted whenever the agent finishes a turn, so finished work is not left unsaved.
description: It is easy to close a terminal with edits that never reached a commit. This Stop hook checks the working tree at the end of every turn and, when files are modified or untracked, shows you a short list of them.
The notice goes to you as a system message and never blocks the agent, so it cannot cause a loop. A clean tree or a folder without Git produces no output.
useWhen: Finish a task and want a reminder to commit
Run long agent sessions that touch many files
Avoid losing work when you close the terminal
Check that a turn left only the files you expected

hook.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(d)}catch(e){}const cp=require('child_process');try{const o=cp.execFileSync('git',['status','--porcelain'],{cwd:j.cwd||process.cwd(),encoding:'utf8',stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']});const l=o.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).filter(Boolean);if(l.length){const s=l.slice(0,10).map(x=>x.slice(3)).join(', ');console.log(JSON.stringify({systemMessage:l.length+' uncommitted file'+(l.length>1?'s':'')+' left in the working tree: '+s+(l.length>10?', and '+(l.length-10)+' more':'')+'.'}))}}catch(e){}process.exit(0)})"

example.prompt: Rename the helper and update its imports.
example.result: When the turn ends you see '4 uncommitted files left in the working tree: src/util.ts, src/api.ts and two more.'

faq.question: Does it stop Claude from finishing?
faq.answer: No. It exits with code 0 and only prints a notice for you, so the turn ends as usual.

faq.question: How many files does it list?
faq.answer: The first ten paths, followed by the number of any others.

access: Runs git status in the project folder
Prints a notice; changes no files
